newsitem.title: USA: Healthdyne says to hold annual mtg in July.
newsitem.headline: Healthdyne says to hold annual mtg in July.

text.p: Healthdyne Technologies Inc said Monday that Invacare Corp had agreed to withdraw its motion seeking to force a Healthdyne annual meeting of shareholders by June 30 and had agreed to the previously scheduled date of July 30.

The company said that if, within 15 days prior to the meeting, Invacare changes either the offer price or the form of consideration it is offering in its hostile tender offer, the company may postpone or adjourn the meeting to a date not later than 15 days from such a change.

The agreement was reached under a Consent Order signed by the United States District Court, Northern District of Georgia, Healthdyne said. The order also provides that either party can apply to the court for relief from its terms.

Invacare, which has launched a $173 million hostile takeover of Healthdyne, announced in April it was seeking a court order to try to compel Healthdyne to hold its annual meeting by June 30 in a bid to replace the company's board of directors at the meeting.
